title.narrative: Providing life-saving medical assistance to earthquake victims

description.narrative: 1- Reducing the deaths of Syrian citizens in the affected areas due to the lack of medical services. 2- Equipping 17 central hospitals with advanced medical devices, which will effectively contribute to the quality of advanced medical services. 3- Providing diagnostic devices will contribute to diagnosing diseases, which will directly contribute to the speed of recovery. 4- Providing life-saving medical services such as kidney dialysis and surgical operations.
Reducing the deaths of Syrian citizens in the affected areas due to the lack of medical services, in addition to raising the quality and efficiency of medical services provided in the affected areas.

The project is based on equipping 17 central hospitals in the earthquake-affected areas with life-saving medical devices in the operating rooms, intensive care, emergency and dialysis departments, in addition to equipping the central sterilization department with equipment, as well as the endoscopy, cardiology and radiology departments. The project includes supplying two CT SCAN devices in addition to radiology, ultrasound and echo devices for the radiology departments. The project also includes providing 10 ambulances in addition to providing a large group of medicines for beneficiaries in the affected areas.
